analyzer_diagnosis.reasoning: The Kconfig warnings indicate that the NVS (Non-Volatile Storage) subsystem is not being enabled because its dependency, FLSH (Flash), is also not enabled. This directly leads to the linker errors, as all the `nvs_` functions (e.g., `nvs_write`, `nvs_read`, `nvs_mount`) and potentially `crc8_ccitt` are part of the NVS subsystem and are therefore not compiled and linked into the final executable. Graph retrieval is needed to understand the Kconfig dependencies of NVS and FLSH and determine why FLSH is not active.
